name: Troccas
summary: Swiss Romansh four-player partnership Tarot game with unique king-jack exchange rule.
rules_text: Troccas uses a 78-card Swiss Tarot. Four players cut for trump; two highest vs two lowest become partners. Play is counter-clockwise. Each player gets 19 cards, dealer gets 22 after dealing in 6-6-7 packets, last card of each hand face up. Dealer must discard two cards, not Kings or Honours (I, XXI of trumps, Fool). Dealer leads. Must follow suit, otherwise must trump if able, otherwise any card but cannot win trick. Fool may be played anytime to excuse from following; its owner keeps it unless their side wins no tricks; if opponents win trick containing Fool they must swap it for a 1-point card. When a suit is led first time and its King is played, winner may demand the Jack of that suit from its holder, who must surrender it unless they played Queen, Cavalier or Fool, taking back their original card. Points: Kings/Honours 5, Queens 4, Cavaliers 3, Jacks 2, others 1, counted in fours minus 3, 72 total. Side over 36 scores difference.
